architecture_deltas.supersedes: No promoted architecture; refines QNDRF-1 candidate ordering only.
proposed_path: MVC-M0 deterministic pooled descriptor + calibrated prototype/open-set decision
if known and non-critical: cheap perceptual-state update without 4B semantic decode
if unknown/ambiguous/conflict/critical: reuse same encoded media tokens for full semantic decode
fallback_ladder: MVC-M1: tiny learnable projection over frozen merged features
MVC-M2: optional same-encode pre-merger + merged two-view descriptor only after M0/M1 falsification
MVC-B: separate lightweight embedding encoder counterbaseline only when measured Pareto-superior

visual_encoder_compatibility_id.law: Prototype/model states from a different compatibility ID are STALE_INCOMPATIBLE until a differential compatibility receipt proves safe reuse.
visual_encoder_compatibility_id.mismatch_behavior: Quarantine stale prototype state and fail open to semantic decode; never silently classify as familiar.

architecture_deltas.expected_benefit: Avoid a duplicate heavy visual backbone and redundant image encode while retaining adaptive familiarity as a bounded, lesionable controller around Qwen's native visual path.
architecture_deltas.strongest_counterhypothesis: A dedicated lightweight embedding encoder can be faster overall because it can answer familiarity without invoking Qwen vision at all and may provide better calibrated geometry.
architecture_deltas.discriminating_test: Matched target-like screenshot/camera fixtures with known, near-neighbor unknown and OOD classes comparing full-decode baseline, merged MVC-M0, merged+tiny-projection MVC-M1 and dedicated encoder MVC-B for open-set risk, routing correctness, end-to-end latency/resources and recovery.
architecture_deltas.rollback: Disable MVC bypass and route every changed visual observation through the full Qwen semantic path using the same provenance-bound Retina ingress.
architecture_deltas.promotion_gate: No promotion before target-compatible runtime evidence shows non-inferior safety/open-set performance and a Pareto advantage or justified complexity benefit.
